title: Comprehensive characterization of gibberellin oxidase gene family in Brassica napus reveals BnGA2ox15 involved in hormone signaling and response to drought stress.
authors: Qin, Tongjun; Huang, Qian; Li, Juanjuan; Ayyaz, Ahsan; Farooq, Muhammad Ahsan; Chen, Weiqi; Zhou, Yingying; Wu, Xiaofen; Ali, Basharat; Zhou, Weijun
one_liner_zh: 该文表征甘蓝型油菜赤霉素氧化酶基因家族，并通过酵母单杂交、双荧光素酶及分子对接研究转录因子BnMYC4/BnAIB与BnGA2ox15启动子的结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作和分子对接，但核心是植物激素与干旱胁迫响应，非TF-DNA结合机制建模为主。
abstract: Brassica napus is a well-known allopolyploid oil crop with high commercial potential. Gibberellin oxidase (GAox) is an essential enzyme that activates gibberellins, which regulate plant growth, and development, and have a significant impact on plant responses to abiotic stress. However, the comprehensive understanding of GAox genes and their evolution in Brassica plants remains elusive. Using advanced bioinformatics tools, this study identified 125 candidate GAox genes from the whole genomes of three key Brassica species. This study also investigated sequence characteristics, conserved motifs, exon/intron structures, cis-acting elements, syntenic analysis, duplication events and expression patterns. Subcellular localization analysis showed that the BnGA2ox14 and BnGA2ox15 proteins are located in the nucleus, whereas BnGA2ox26 is specifically localized to the chloroplast. Yeast one-hybrid and dual-luciferase assays demonstrated that MYELOCYTOMATOSIS 4 (BnMYC4) and ABA-INDUCIBLE BHLH-TYPE TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR (BnAIB) bind to the BnGA2ox15 promoter and activate its transcription. Molecular docking analysis further elucidated their interaction structures and identified potential binding sites. Roots transformations show that overexpression of BnGA2ox15 increased sensitivity to PEG-6000 treatment in rapeseed. In brief, this study reveals that BnGA2ox15 is a downstream target in JA and ABA signaling pathways, functioning as a negative regulator in response to drought stress.
abstract_zh: 甘蓝型油菜（Brassica napus）是一种众所周知的异源多倍体油料作物，具有很高的商业潜力。赤霉素氧化酶（Gibberellin oxidase, GAox）是激活赤霉素的关键酶，赤霉素调节植物生长和发育，并对植物响应非生物胁迫具有显著影响。然而，对甘蓝型油菜及其近缘种中GAox基因及其进化的全面理解仍不明确。利用先进的生物信息学工具，本研究从三种关键芸薹属物种的全基因组中鉴定出125个候选GAox基因。本研究还调查了序列特征、保守基序、外显子/内含子结构、顺式作用元件、共线性分析、复制事件和表达模式。亚细胞定位分析显示，BnGA2ox14和BnGA2ox15蛋白定位于细胞核，而BnGA2ox26特异性地定位于叶绿体。酵母单杂交和双荧光素酶实验表明，骨髓细胞瘤病4（BnMYC4）和ABA诱导型bHLH型转录因子（BnAIB）结合到BnGA2ox15启动子并激活其转录。分子对接分析进一步阐明了它们的相互作用结构并识别了潜在结合位点。根部转化显示，BnGA2ox15的过表达增加了油菜对PEG-6000处理的敏感性。总之，本研究揭示BnGA2ox15是JA和ABA信号通路中的下游靶标，作为响应干旱胁迫的负调控因子发挥作用。
